messages:
nina: UX review: regression diff timeline and compact scorecard drill-in. Uploaded updated mock. Two main asks from PM: 1) make the regression timeline more discoverable, 2) avoid duplication between the scorecard header and the timeline filter.

lia: Timeline should be sticky but collapsed by default in compact mode. Show a subtle chevron with 'Recent regressions (3)' when collapsed. Clicking expands into the timeline view. That reduces clutter.

own: Agree. Also add a small filter pill in the header that mirrors the timeline state (e.g., 'Showing: regressions'). Clicking the pill should expand the timeline. Keep them in sync.

tara: Accessibility: collapsed timeline needs an aria-expanded toggle and a keyboard affordance (space/enter to toggle). Also ensure timeline items have accessible names like 'Regressed on March 8: 4 failures' and the chevron has aria-controls pointing to the timeline container.

nina: For the scorecard drill-in, some users reported losing context when jumping to an example: the header loses the run summary and breadcrumbs. Proposal: keep a small breadcrumb bar at the top of the drill-in with back link that includes run summary counts (e.g., '< Back  42 examples  6 failures').

lia: Breadcrumb with summary is good. Make it compact and persistent across narrow viewports. Use smaller typography so it doesn't crowd the example content.

own: Regarding duplication: remove the timeline filter from the main header if the pill exists; otherwise it's redundant. I prefer keeping the pill since it's interactive and concise.

tara: Also: when keyboard-navigating into the drill-in, focus should land on the back link so users can quickly return. Add `tabindex=0` on the breadcrumb container and `aria-label` on the back link.

nina: Another microcopy item: change 'Regression history' label to 'Recent regressions' to reduce jargon.

lia: For compact density, hide avatar images in the timeline; show only a small dot + timestamp. Avatars add visual noise without much value in that view.

own: Mini preview on hover for the timeline items would be neat — same behavior as diffs: keyboard focus shows preview, Escape closes. Keep previews small to avoid occluding the main content.

tara: Ensure previews are announced when they appear: `aria-live=polite` region describing preview content like 'Preview: Changed tokenization in response header'.

ai-evals-bot: Regression alert: recent run 1762102468 contains 3 new regressions. See timeline.

nina: Action items: 1) Lia  collapse-first timeline + pill state; 2) Owen  remove duplicate filter and design pill interactions + hover previews; 3) Tara  accessibility bits for toggle, focus, aria-live; 4) Me  update copy + push new fig prototype. Due: end of sprint.

lia: Will update mock and include narrow viewport states.

own: I'll prototype the preview behavior in sandbox.

tara: I'll add aria snippets and test flow with VoiceOver.

nina: Thanks team. Let's keep the timeline collapsed by default in the next A/B test to measure engagement.
